0022600151.text: The Bucks (1-3) host the Cavaliers (3-1), who have won three straight and sit 0.5 games ahead of Milwaukee in the Central, while the Bucks are 2.5 games back in fifth place and 13th in the East. Milwaukee is 1-1 at home and 0-2 on the road, and this is its sixth game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-3, including a 123-116 loss in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
